verdict_reason: The new organisation-header assertion cannot fail because of a test-env fallback to the same value, and the four added beforeEach bindings copy set-up journeyRequest already does, via a deprecated alias.

todos.issue: The organisation-header test (title line 357, assert line 375) cannot fail if the session's organisation stops reaching the request: headers.js falls back to '5900001' whenever NODE_ENV is 'test' (vitest's default), and '5900001' is exactly the value bound here and by journeyRequest (test-support.js:164, authenticatedCredentials.organisationId). Remove every binding and the assertion still passes, so the test does not prove the AC that the value comes from the verified session.
todos.fix: Must: the test fails when the signed-in organisation is not what the request carries; it asserts an organisation value no fallback can produce, taken from the request's credentials, and the title says the header carries the signed-in organisation. One way: build the request with credentials for a distinct organisation (e.g. '5900077') and assert that value, and drop the NODE_ENV==='test' fallback in http/headers.js so a missing binding throws in tests as in production.

todos.issue: Lines 230, 354, 385 and 443 each add bindOrganisationId('5900001') to a beforeEach, copying set-up the shared helper already does: every test in those describes builds its request with journeyRequest, which binds authenticatedCredentials.organisationId ('5900001') itself (test-support.js:164). The copies also hard-code the literal instead of the shared credential, and import (line 36) the alias organisation-id.js marks @deprecated in favour of enterOrganisationIdForTests.
todos.fix: Must: the organisation binding for these tests lives in one place, the shared test helper, with no local copies and no use of the deprecated alias. One way: delete the four beforeEach bindOrganisationId calls and the line 36 import, relying on journeyRequest; if a describe needs a binding without journeyRequest, call enterOrganisationIdForTests(authenticatedCredentials.organisationId).
